_help: Announcements shown as a banner at the top of every page between `from` and `until` (YYYY-MM-DD, both optional). `tone` is info or warning. To cancel one week of a weekly session, add the date to `cancelled` in that event's file instead; its notice is created automatically.

notices.text: Emergency General Meeting on Monday 9 November, 17:00 in the Robotics Lab: we're electing a new Vice President.
